name: Obduracy
overview: Scripture reveals obduracy as a hardened, unrepentant heart that resists God's compassionate outreach through His messengers, as seen in 2 Chronicles 36:15-16 where God's repeated warnings were mocked and despised, leading to His righteous wrath without remedy. The Psalms (95:8-11) further illustrate this stubbornness by recalling Israel's rebellion in the wilderness, where their refusal to know God's ways and their persistent temptation of Him caused divine grief and an oath that they would not enter His rest. Together, these passages emphasize the serious consequences of persistent hardness of heart against God's gracious dealings.
